newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lincoln Nat awaits final Singapore go-ahead.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln Nat awaits final Singapore go-ahead.

text.p: Lincoln National Reassurance has received approval in principle for the opening of a life and health reinsurance underwriting office in Singapore, the company said on Tuesday.

Final approval from the Monetary Authority of Singapore is expected in the next few months, and the new office will be known as LNR Southeast Asia, said Ian Rickard, who will become its managing director when authority is granted.
Lincoln National is the latest in a flood of western insurers and reinsurers to set up operations in Singapore in order to access markets in Asia.
It follows similar bids by firms such as Mid Ocean, Kemper Re and CNA, and, if approved, would bring the total of foreign insurers in the Republic to around 40.
"We intend to bring exceptional support to life and health insurers in Asia, helping them to reach their business goals," said Rickard.
"The market is complex, but there are numerous opportunities we see for our clients," he said.
Rickard added that he expected to focus primarily on newly emerging markets where growth is rapid, rather than the more mature markets in the north of the region.

The planned new office will work in tandem with another in Manila, the Philippines. Rickard said the two may split the region in terms of marketing, but that both would report back to the group's U.S. headquarters in Fort Wayne, Indiana.
